epic.title: Price Alerts & Watchlist
epic.description: Allow retail investors to monitor price movements on securities they care about and receive timely notifications when target prices are crossed.
epic.businessValue: Increases 7-day active user rate from 22% to 31% by reducing the need for users to monitor competitor apps for price movements. Users who receive a timely alert are 4.2× more likely to execute the trade on TradeEasy.

features.title: Watchlist Management
features.description: Users can build and manage a personal list of securities they want to monitor, with real-time quote data.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add any US equity or ETF ticker to their watchlist from search results or ticker detail screens
The watchlist displays real-time or near-real-time price updates for all tickers during market hours
Users can remove tickers from their watchlist with a single swipe-left gesture
Users can reorder watchlist items by drag-and-drop, with the order persisting across sessions and devices

features.title: Price Alert Creation & Delivery
features.description: Users can set price-crossing alerts on any watchlist item and receive timely push or email notifications when the threshold is met.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a price alert for any watchlist ticker by specifying a target price and alert type (above/below/crosses)
When the market price crosses the alert threshold, the system sends a push notification within 60 seconds during market hours
Users can view all active alerts in a dedicated Alerts screen, grouped by ticker
Users can edit or delete existing alerts, with changes taking effect immediately
One-time alerts are automatically deactivated after firing; recurring alerts remain active until manually deleted

features.title: Alert History & Analytics
features.description: Users can review past alerts, see which ones they acted on, and gain insights into their monitoring patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: The app displays a history of all fired alerts for the past 90 days, showing ticker, trigger price, and timestamp
Users can filter alert history by ticker, date range, or whether they resulted in a trade
The system tracks conversion rate: what percentage of alerts led to a trade within 24 hours
Users can see aggregate stats: total alerts set, total fired, most-watched tickers

outOfScope: Custom alert sounds or notification tones (use system defaults)
Alerts based on percentage change, volume spikes, or technical indicators (price-crossing only for MVP)
Sharing watchlists with other users or importing from external sources
Watchlist folders or grouping (single flat list for MVP)
